name: Dr. Ananya Sundaram
about: Dr. Ananya Sundaram is a senior consultant physician specializing in infectious diseases, chronic lifestyle condition management (diabetes & hypertension), and adult preventive immunizations. With over 14 years of clinical experience in Tamil Nadu, she emphasizes clear patient communication and evidence-based diagnostic protocols.
education: MD (General Medicine) - Stanley Medical College, Chennai
Fellowship in Adult Diabetology - Royal College of Physicians (Edin)
experience: Senior Physician - CareSphere Clinic Kanchipuram (2020 - Present)
Resident Physician - Government General Hospital Chennai (2010 - 2014)

faqs.question: Does Dr. Ananya offer video consultations?
faqs.answer: Yes, online consultations are available Monday through Friday from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

faqs.question: What should I bring for my first consultation?
faqs.answer: Please bring any previous lab reports, prescription slips, blood sugar logs, and current medication boxes.

name: Dr. Karthik Raghavan
about: Dr. Karthik Raghavan is a distinguished consultant cardiologist with expertise in preventive cardiology, hypertensive heart disease, ECG/Echo diagnostics, and lipid disorders.
education: DM (Cardiology) - Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education
experience: Chief Consultant Cardiologist - CareSphere Clinic (2019 - Present)

faqs.question: Are cardiac diagnostic tests available at the clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes, 12-lead ECG, 2D Echo, and stress tests are performed on-site at CareSphere Kanchipuram.

name: Dr. Priya Natarajan
about: Dr. Priya Natarajan specializes in pediatric care, child growth monitoring, newborn nutrition, childhood asthma, and childhood immunizations under national and IAP schedules.
education: DCH - Institute of Child Health, Egmore, Chennai
experience: Pediatric Specialist - CareSphere Clinic Kanchipuram (2021 - Present)

faqs.question: Do you administer pediatric vaccines on the same day?
faqs.answer: Yes, our certified cold-chain vaccine bank stocks all IAP recommended vaccines.

name: Dr. V. Subramanian
about: Senior Orthopaedic consultant with extensive practice in joint disorders, sports injury rehab, osteoarthritis management, spine care, and fracture treatments.
experience: Orthopaedic Consultant - CareSphere Clinic Kanchipuram (2018 - Present)

faqs.question: Are physiotherapy sessions coordinated with doctor visits?
faqs.answer: Yes, our on-site physiotherapy center coordinates directly with Dr. Subramanian for customized rehabilitation.

name: Dr. Deepa Chandran
about: Expert in women's wellness, prenatal counselling, PCOS management, adolescent menstrual health, and menopause care.

faqs.question: Can I do pelvic ultrasound scans during the visit?
faqs.answer: Yes, high-resolution pelvic ultrasound scans are performed in our diagnostic wing.

name: Dr. Suresh Balaji
about: Consultant Dermatologist and Venereologist focused on acne protocols, eczema, psoriasis, fungal skin infections, and hair fall therapies.
education: MBBS - PSG Institute of Medical Sciences
MD (Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy) - Madras Medical College

faqs.question: Are chemical peels and skin procedures done at Kanchipuram clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a sterile minor procedure suite for clinical dermatology procedures.

name: Dr. Meenakshi Swaminathan
about: Specialist in metabolic wellness, Type 1 & 2 diabetes management, thyroid dysfunctions (hypo/hyperthyroidism), and diabetic foot ulcer prevention.
education: Post Graduate Diploma in Diabetology - MV Diabetes Hospital
experience: Diabetologist - Dr. Mohan's Diabetes Specialities Centre (2014 - 2019)

faqs.question: Do you offer HbA1c testing on the same day?
faqs.answer: Yes, our laboratory gives certified HbA1c results within 45 minutes.

name: Dr. Arun Prakash
about: Consultant ENT surgeon with special interest in chronic sinusitis, allergic rhinitis, hearing loss assessments, vertigo, and throat disorders.

faqs.question: Do you provide ear wax microsuction at the clinic?
